notes: Magento site, UAE storefront /ae-en/. HTTP fetch worked directly, no block. No page called Clearance/Outlet/Final Clearance/Last Chance/End of Line exists in main nav, footer nav, or sitemap.xml (checked 2.5MB sitemap for clearance|outlet|final-sale|last-chance|end-of-line|discontinued, case-insensitive). Two sale-worded pages were found and inspected: (1) 'DSS Final Sale' (https://ochomefurniture.com/ae-en/dss-final-sale, category11517, real PLP with toolbar count 177 Item(s), facets Homeware=173/Furniture=4) - DSS = Dubai Summer Surprises, a well-known annual UAE-wide seasonal retail festival (roughly June-Sept), so despite the page literally using the target term 'Final Sale', the DSS prefix and no on-page copy about permanent markdown/outlet stock make this read as a temporary seasonal campaign tied to that festival, not a permanent clearance/outlet listing per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test. Recorded below with a manual-review flag rather than silently guessing either way. (2) 'Payday Sale' (https://ochomefurniture.com/ae-en/payday-sale, category10392, toolbar count 12 Item(s)) - a recurring monthly promotional sale (paycheck-timed), commented out of the live mobile nav markup (not currently linked from any live navigation), no clearance/outlet permanence signal at all - excluded entirely, not recorded as a row. Site's internal catalogsearch (?q=clearance, ?q=outlet) returned non-discriminating flat layered-nav facet results (every filter option shows count '10' regardless of query), so it was not used as evidence of presence or absence, consistent with a known false-absence/false-signal search pattern on some Magento builds. No sub_category-level clearance children (e.g. 'Furniture Clearance') exist; DSS Final Sale's Homeware/Furniture split is a query-string layered-nav filter, not a separate site-defined page.
